name: Wide-Lens Gem Sweep
description: Discover high-value additions to the owner's own toolkit by fanning ~40 INDEPENDENT discovery lenses and converging to a tiered adopt / build / prune queue. The merge that makes this worth running is the DEDUP GROUNDING stage: the wide-roster source workflow had no grounding pass and re-proposed things already built, while the narrow source had grounding but only 14 lenses. Grounding runs FIRST so no lens can propose an existing capability, and the adopt/prune judgement is delegated to BP-GEM-02 as a SUBWORKFLOW rather than reimplemented here - discovery and judgement stay separable. The blueprint has NO write permission outside its artifact root, which is what makes a 40-agent sweep safe to run.

scope.description: What the sweep is hunting over

lens_roster.description: One independent discovery lens per entry; the roster IS the reproducibility surface

already_built_inventory.description: Inventory of what already exists; without it every lens re-proposes the estate back to itself

absorption_budget.description: Items the estate will actually build this cycle - discovery without a budget manufactures a backlog

include_codex_arm.description: Optional S1b: a cross-vendor Codex lens set

artifact_root.description: The ONLY writable root: discovery has no other write permission

grounding-agent.description: Enumerates what already exists so no lens can propose it; produces the dedup set every lens is briefed with

discovery-lens.description: One lens, one angle, no sight of sibling lenses; a lens that finds nothing records a NULL RESULT with its search surface

codex-lens.description: Cross-vendor lens set: independent failure modes, not extra headcount

synthesiser.description: Merges and dedupes the lens output; may not add a candidate no lens produced

queue-builder.description: Turns judged candidates into an owner-consumable decision queue, one line per decision

owner.description: The human owner - the only role that sets the absorption budget and accepts the queue

routes.reason: a cross-vendor arm names options no in-vendor lens names

stages.title: Enumerate what already exists so no lens can re-propose it

work_unit.title: Build the dedup set from the already-built inventory and the estate itself
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce the dedup set: every capability that already exists in scope, with the path or identifier that proves it. This set is injected into every lens brief, so a lens proposing an existing capability is a defect, not a duplicate to filter later.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every row carries the path or identifier that proves the capability exists; a row with no locator is dropped and the drop is recorded
tests_required: MANDATORY dedup control: a KNOWN-BUILT item must appear in the dedup set; if it does not, the merge that justifies this blueprint has failed
a missing already_built_inventory must FAIL this stage, never yield an empty dedup set that silently permits every proposal
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the synthesiser rejects any candidate that string- or semantically matches a dedup-set row and records the match
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0101 emitted only when the dedup set exists, is non-empty, and every row carries a locator; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0101 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two attempts, ask the owner for the inventory rather than proceeding without one

stages.title: No lens launches until the dedup set exists and is in every brief
Fan out the lens roster, staggered, each blind to its siblings

body.title: Run one discovery lens against the dedup set

work_unit.title: Emit candidates for one lens, or a null result naming the surface searched
work_unit.question_or_target: For the assigned lens, emit candidates that are NOT in the dedup set, each with an external anchor or a file:line. A lens that finds nothing emits a NULL RESULT naming the surface it searched - absence of evidence must be attributable to a search.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every candidate carries an external URL or a file:line plus its licence where third-party; a null result carries the queries run
tests_required: a lens pointed at a KNOWN-BUILT item must return it as deduped, never as a new candidate
a lens with nothing to report must emit a null result with its search surface, not an empty file
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the anti-overfit gate subworkflow judges every survivor; this lens does not judge its own candidates
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0102 emitted only when the lens file exists, parses, and each candidate has an anchor or the file is an explicit null result; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0102 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failures, record the lens as a null result with the failure attached

stages.title: Optional S1b: a cross-vendor Codex lens set

work_unit.title: Run a cross-vendor lens set with the prompt passed BY FILE
work_unit.question_or_target: Dispatch a Codex lens set for the same scope, prompt passed BY FILE and blocking, and mark every candidate no in-vendor lens produced. Exit 0 alone is SEVERED, not success: the result must also be a non-empty schema-valid file.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor discovery: independent failure modes, not extra headcount

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the dispatch records exit code, the output file path, its byte count and its schema verdict - all three, because exit 0 alone is not a result
tests_required: a prompt above the Windows command-line limit must go by FILE and succeed, not fail with an argument-length error
a killed peer must produce a terminal FAILED marker with the diagnostic tail, never silence
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the synthesiser marks cross-vendor-only candidates explicitly so their independence is visible in the queue
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0103 emitted only when exit 0 AND a non-empty output file AND a schema-valid parse - or a terminal FAILED marker; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0103 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: retry ONCE ignoring user config on an argument-limit failure, then stop

stages.title: A silent lens is a defect: every empty lens must name its search surface
Merge and dedupe the lens output against the grounding set

work_unit.title: Produce one deduped candidate list with per-candidate provenance and lens attribution
work_unit.question_or_target: Merge every lens output into one list: dedupe against the grounding set AND against sibling lenses, attribute each survivor to the lenses that found it, and add nothing no lens produced.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each survivor names every lens that produced it and its anchor; each dedup drop names the grounding row or sibling it matched
tests_required: MANDATORY: a candidate identical to a dedup-set row must be dropped with the matched row named - this is the measurement that the merge works
a candidate the synthesiser invented (no lens attribution) must be rejected
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: an adversarial reviewer receives the siblings' FULL lens text, not the digest, and checks for a survivor that duplicates a dropped one
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0104 emitted only when the candidate list exists, parses, every survivor has at least one lens attribution, and every drop names its match; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0104 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failures emit the partial list plus the unmerged lens files

stages.title: Delegate adopt / build / prune to the anti-overfit gate (a subworkflow, not a copy)
Build the owner-consumable tiered decision queue

work_unit.title: Emit the T0-T3 decision queue with one actionable line per candidate
work_unit.question_or_target: Turn the judged candidates into a decision queue: T0-T3 tier, the adopt/build/prune verdict with its reason code, the effort estimate, and whether it fits the absorption budget. Prose is not a deliverable here; the queue is.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every row carries tier, verdict, reason code and budget-fit; the count of rows above the budget is stated numerically
tests_required: a queue with more T0 items than the absorption budget must state the overflow explicitly rather than silently truncating
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner reads the queue; a queue longer than the budget with no overflow statement is rejected
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0105 emitted only when the queue exists, parses, and reconciles its T0 count against the absorption budget; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0105 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: Owner accepts the queue and confirms the absorption budget
stages.prompt: The sweep produced a tiered decision queue. Accept it as the cycle's build list, trim it to the absorption budget, or reject the sweep. Discovery beyond what the estate will absorb becomes a backlog, so an over-budget queue needs an explicit decision.

impact.blast_radius: DISCOVERY ONLY: no write permission outside command-center/sweeps/**; that separation is what makes a 40-agent sweep safe

derived_from.credit: owner (~40-lens roster, opus pinning, codex arm, resume)
owner (the dedup GROUNDING stage and T0-T3 tiering)

contraindications: NOT for interrogating one existing plan - that is a requirements grill
NOT for ordinary topic research - that is BP-RES-01
NOT when the estate cannot absorb more surface: discovery without an absorption budget manufactures a backlog
x_extensions.why_not_a_duplicate_of_bp_gem_02: This blueprint DISCOVERS and produces a candidate list; BP-GEM-02 only JUDGES a list it did not produce. The relationship is composition, not overlap: the judge-candidates stage CALLS BP-GEM-02 as a subworkflow rather than reimplementing its anchor and budget checks.
unverified: UNVERIFIED post-merge; settling experiment = re-run both source workflows and the merged form on the same scope and count DUPLICATE-of-already-built proposals - the merged form should approach zero, and the dedup control test is the floor.
x_extensions.owner_decision: Merge the two source sweeps into this one canonical form, or keep the narrow 14-lens variant as a cheap mode?

worked_example.name: sweep for missing harness capabilities with 8 lenses

params.scope: capabilities the agent harness is missing relative to comparable frontier tooling

acceptance: a known-built item is deduped by the grounding stage, not re-proposed
every lens that found nothing carries its search surface
the queue states its T0 overflow against the budget of 6

stopping_rule_controls.why: the floor stops an early barren lens from ending a sweep before six lenses have returned
the sweep ends when the roster is spent even if candidates were still arriving
